found.truth_sql: SELECT sumOrNull(if((toStartOfYear(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'UTC')) >= addYears(toStartOfYear(now('UTC')), -400) AND toStartOfYear(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'UTC')) < toStartOfYear(now('UTC'))), 1, 0)) AS c0 FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE 1 SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
